title: BiMi Sheets: Infosheets for bias mitigation methods

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure a specific societal bias. Instead, it proposes and evaluates a standardized documentation framework (BiMi Sheets) designed to systematically record the design choices, fairness definitions (e.g., Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds), and sensitive attribute constraints of various algorithmic bias mitigation methods.
